doc.title: Joel Dorn interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 13, 2007

title: Closing thanks and advice to future archive listeners
summary: Monk Rowe thanks Dorn. Dorn addresses future listeners and urges them to follow their passion.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well you sure did and you sure are. So I’ve enjoyed talking to you today. I knew it would be a great pleasure.

It’s always nice to talk to you. And I hope someday somebody — hello out there in Archive-land — I hope someday some poor innocent child is going through these archives and goes, “Dorn, Dorn, let me see, I like his music, let me take a look at what he’s like.” And then they found out — a blithering idiot can actually do something. So for all the kids who got thrown out of school, you know, like all of that stuff, there’s hope for your children. Find something you dig and go do it because you don’t have to follow the rules all the time, you just have to have rules of your own. And on that pleasant note I’m off to help others. My work here is done. Good to see you again baby.
